import json
from work import evaluate
base={'defaults':{'s':'d','b':True,'i':1},'types':{'s':'string','b':'boolean','i':'integer'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
cases=[
('layer_order',{'layers':[{'i':2},{'i':0}]},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'s':'d','b':True,'i':0},'error':None}),
('unknown_precedence',{'layers':[{'i':True},{'x':1}],'environment':{'b':'TRUE'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
('environment_precedence',{'layers':[{'i':True}],'environment':{'b':'TRUE'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('null_no_reset',{'layers':[{'s':None}]},{**base,'null_resets':False},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
('disabled_environment_ignored',{'environment':{'x':'1','i':'+2'}},{**base,'environment':False},{'ok':True,'config':{'s':'d','b':True,'i':1},'error':None}),
('exact_values',{'layers':[{'s':'','b':False,'i':0}]},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'s':'','b':False,'i':0},'error':None}),
('integer_minus',{'environment':{'i':'-12'}},base,{'ok':True,'config':{'s':'d','b':True,'i':-12},'error':None}),
('integer_spaces',{'environment':{'i':' 1'}},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('bool_not_integer',{'layers':[{'i':False}]},base,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),
]
for name,request,policy,expected in cases:
 actual=evaluate(request,policy)
 assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
 assert set(actual)=={'ok','config','error'}
print('boundary cases passed:',len(cases))

import json
from work import evaluate
p=json.load(open('policy.json'))
r=json.load(open('requests.json'))
actual=[evaluate(x,p) for x in r]
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert actual==report,(actual,report)
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for item in report:
 assert set(item)==set(schema['required'])
 assert set(item)<=set(schema['properties'])
print('report matches requests:',len(report))
